A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''officer''' served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Though the commander was particularly effective, he was corrupt and considered a brutal [[Officer/Legends|officer]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Fouchiert]] successfully exposed the man's actions to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="TOR" />
